planes.purpose: Capture exact time-bound source observations and externally governed evidence.
Generate bounded relationship and reuse-candidate signals from multiple detector classes.
Record strongest opposition, alternative explanations, and rejection conditions before extraction.
Measure real consumer integration, rollback, failure isolation, and maintenance economics.
Invalidate stale evidence and surface possible sibling/dependent effects after subject movement.

detector_ladder.limitations: Does not establish semantic equivalence, ownership, or reuse value.
Structural similarity does not prove equivalent semantics or provenance.
Similar interface shape may hide incompatible authority or lifecycle semantics.
Matching observed behavior may be input-limited and does not prove implementation identity.
Broad-recall nomination only; vulnerable to false equivalence, benchmark shortcuts, and model overinterpretation.

objections.challenge: Discovery can become a de facto central authority even without formal runtime authority.
objections.guard: DELETE_DISCOVERY invariant and no project-local runtime dependency.

objections.challenge: Structural and semantic detectors can manufacture plausible false relationships.
objections.guard: D1-D5 ceilings at HYPOTHESIS plus exact bindings and independent corroboration.

objections.challenge: Graph staleness can create false confidence.
objections.guard: Fail-closed invalidation on exact subject movement.

objections.challenge: Reuse metrics can be gamed by counting deleted lines while ignoring complexity.
objections.guard: Multi-dimensional economics including adapters, tests, dependencies, rollback, blast radius, and propagation.

objections.challenge: Negative controls can become an excuse to preserve all duplication.
objections.guard: Repeated sibling fixes or recurring equivalent maintenance shift burden toward extraction experiments.

objections.challenge: Discovery-generated inference can recursively validate itself.
objections.guard: No self-corroboration; derived claims trace to external exact or executable evidence.

objections.challenge: The observatory may cost more to maintain than the duplication it studies.
objections.guard: Detector/plugin kill criterion when repeated portfolio value is not demonstrated.

first_implementation_target.reason: Discovery currently validates snapshots more strongly than it produces them.
